geo_notes: Address confirmed in the site footer (5297 Westside Rd, Healdsburg, CA 95448, 707-433-2440, info@bishopsranch.org). Coordinates from the site's own Google Maps link (maps.app.goo.gl/gjBtWbBWVxf1946q6 -> 'The Bishop's Ranch' place pin at 38.5440405,-122.8739636). Cross-checked against OSM, which has a landuse polygon named 'The Bishop's Ranch' (website bishopsranch.org) centered at 38.5446744,-122.8735674, ~70 m away. The property is about 7 km southwest of downtown Healdsburg on Westside Road above the Russian River; Nominatim's address search only returned the Westside Road segment near town (38.606,-122.877), which is NOT the property and was discarded.

notes: Wix site; originals were fetched by stripping everything after /v1/ from the static.wixstatic.com URLs (most are 2000 px on the long side). Founded 1947 when the Episcopal Diocese of California bought the Ranch House and 63 acres; now a 501(c)(3) on 365 acres. Group Reservations page states the Ranch 'exclusively hosts nonprofit groups who exist for religious, charitable or community benefit' and gives priority booking to Exclusive Use and recurring groups (including Diocese parishes). Site sections: Facilities, Dining, Sample Packages, Pricing Structure, Inquire Now; also individual retreats, life events, summer camp, Chapel of St. George. Staff headshots on the About page were excluded from image candidates.
